descripcion_geo: Mediterranean island south of Sicily, in the strait between the western and eastern Mediterranean.
importancia_estrategica: Strategic island on the sea route between Rome and the East.

historias.descripcion: The ship carrying Paul to Rome is wrecked in Malta; everyone survives.
A viper bites Paul on the hand; The Maltese wait for him to die, but nothing happens to him.

historias.titulo: Healing of the father of Publius
historias.descripcion: Paul heals the father of Chief Publius through prayer and laying on of hands.

personajes.descripcion: Shipwrecked in Malta; His three-month stay resulted in healings and testimony.
He received the shipwrecked; Paul healed his father.
Centurion in charge of transferring Paul to Rome; He treated it with consideration.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Island with a mixture of Phoenician and Roman culture; the Paul episode there inaugurated the Maltese Christian tradition.

cristianismo.descripcion: The Maltese interpret Paul's immunity to viper bite as a divine sign; The episode prefigures apostolic power over evil.
cristianismo.significado_teologico: The Maltese interpret Paul's immunity to viper bite as a divine sign; The episode prefigures apostolic power over evil.
